# Studying in Germany

> > Your comprehensive guide to studying, living, and experiencing life in Germany, covering culture, customs, language, and practical information for international students and expats.

Studying in Germany provides essential information for international students and visitors planning to study or live in Germany. The site covers German culture, traditions, language, and practical aspects of life in major cities like Berlin, Munich, Hamburg, and Cologne.

## Key Topics

- Germany
- German culture and customs
- Study abroad in Germany
- Living in Germany
- German language
- Berlin
- Munich
- Hamburg
- Cologne
- German traditions
- Cultural adaptation
- International students
- Bavarian culture
- German cities
- Religion in Germany

## German Culture & Customs

- [German Culture: Facts, Customs, Traditions, and Things To Know](http://www.studying-in-germany.org/german-culture/): Guide to German culture, customs, and traditions in Berlin, Munich, Cologne
